tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange, unchanged from v1. Identity only: app tiles, brand mark backgrounds, active nav indicator, unread dots, progress fills, large text (24px+). Never small text on light grounds (3.47:1 on surface) and never behind 14px white text.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and focus ring. White text on it holds 4.55:1. Former --accent-dark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text: links, eyebrow labels, inline actions. 5.06:1 on surface-soft, 4.92:1 on accent-soft, 5.1:1 on surface-warm.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active list item, soft badge ground, icon tile ground. Text on it: ink or accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Hover wash on accent-soft items, chart area fill. Never a text ground on its own.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-soft, surface-warm, accent-soft (17:1+).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table cells, descriptions, form values that are not the focus. 7.4:1 on surface-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: helper text, timestamps, column headers, metadata. Replaces v1 --muted for text (4.85:1 on surface-soft, 5.2:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: v1 --muted. Placeholders, disabled labels and decorative icons only: 3.41:1 on surface, below the 4.5:1 text floor, kept for non-essential text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on navy, navy-raised, accent-strong, accent-hover.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy (6.6:1) and navy-raised (5.0:1): sidebar section labels, user role.

tokens.name: accent-on-navy
tokens.usage: Orange text on navy surfaces (8:1): eyebrow labels and code hints inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, inputs, topbar.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: App background behind panels; table header; filter bar; code field ground.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and list-item hover on surface; ghost button hover.

tokens.name: surface-warm
tokens.usage: Home launcher background wash and onboarding callouts. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: App sidebar, brand mark tile, dark app tile (CRM), tooltips. Same value as ink.

tokens.name: navy-raised
tokens.usage: Active and hover nav item inside the sidebar, workspace switcher on navy.

tokens.name: navy-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, table row dividers, panel separators. Decorative: not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card, between list items.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and secondary button borders (3.16:1 on surface, meets the 3:1 control boundary floor).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and dot; success text on surface (4.9:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and callout ground. Text on it: success-text.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft (5.5:1). v1 used #16805c here at 4.44:1.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning icon and dot.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and callout ground. Text on it: warn-text.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Text on warn-soft (5.7:1). v1 used #a76706 here at 4.16:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger icon, destructive button fill (white text 5.2:1), error text on surface and danger-soft (4.7:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error badge, invalid field ground, error callout ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral info badge text on info-soft (8:1): queued, draft, n/a states.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral/info badge and callout ground.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home launcher heading only. One per screen.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Page title in PageHeader. Replaces the 54-72px v1 titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and modal titles, empty-state title.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: List item name, section header inside a card, conversation header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Conversazioni, BOT, template Twilio e broadcast.
styles.usage: Default UI text, table cells, inputs, message bubbles.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in lists, descriptions under titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, nav items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, badge text. The smallest size in the system: nothing below 12px.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above page titles and table column headers. Uppercase is the only exception to the 12px floor.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Webhook URLs, Content SID, Account SID, API paths, phone numbers in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text gap inside badges; stacked caption offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap in buttons; gap between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; list item padding; gap in filter bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (dense); gap between form fields; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter; gap between cards; page header bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Home launcher top padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, kbd, tags. v1: 8px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, code fields. v1: 11px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables, popovers, message bubbles. v1: 15-20px.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, home app tiles. Largest radius in the system (v1 had 26px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatar, segmented control track, unread counters.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and panels at rest (with line border). Replaces v1 shadow (18px/48px blur), which blurred panel edges.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, hovered app tile.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, command palette, toasts.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs inside tables, toolbars, filter bar.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Composer input, primary call to action in empty states, touch targets.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Data table row (comfortable). 40px when the user picks compact density.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Topbar height in the app shell.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded app sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed app sidebar (icons only).

tokens.name: pane-list
tokens.usage: Conversation list pane in the inbox.

tokens.name: pane-detail
tokens.usage: Contact detail pane in the inbox and record drawers.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of form and settings pages. Tables use full width.
